hero.title: Cultivated with precision. Exported globally.
hero.desc: Discover our range of premium, certified organic crops and seeds. Grown in the nutrient-rich soils of the Great Rift Valley by our network of cooperative farmers.
hero.imageAlt: Fresh harvest of red tomatoes in wooden crate on dark Ethiopian soil

catalog.title: Premium Produce & Certified Seeds
catalog.desc: Browse our high-yield vegetables, fruits, and certified seed varieties grown across 6,065.25 irrigated hectares in the Great Rift Valley.

tomatoes.name: Rift Valley Tomatoes
tomatoes.desc: High-yield, disease-resistant varieties suited for both local consumption and export markets. Known for robust flavor and long shelf life.

onions.name: Red Onion
onions.desc: Pungent, dense bulbs with excellent storage capacity, cultivated in ideal dry conditions.

peppers.name: Green Pepper
peppers.desc: Crisp, thick-walled bell peppers favored by domestic retailers and processing units.

potato.name: Highland Potato
potato.desc: Nutrient-dense varieties grown in higher altitudes, ensuring firm texture and versatility.

green-beans.name: Green Beans
green-beans.desc: Tender fine beans harvested by hand and pre-cooled for premium international markets.

cabbage.name: White Head Cabbage
cabbage.desc: Dense, tightly packed green heads grown under organic soil management practices.

papaya.name: Fresh Papaya
papaya.desc: Sweet, export-grade solo papayas cultivated under strict GlobalG.A.P standards.

watermelon.name: Rift Valley Watermelon
watermelon.desc: Juicy, deep red flesh watermelons grown in dry lowland soils with high natural sugar content.

maize-seed.name: Hybrid Maize Seed
maize-seed.desc: High-yield, drought-tolerant certified maize seed varieties multiplied and processed for member co-ops and regional distribution.

bean-seed.name: Certified Bean Seed
bean-seed.desc: Certified high-germination haricot and common bean seed varieties adapted for Rift Valley growing conditions.

onion-seed.name: Certified Onion Seed
onion-seed.desc: High-grade onion seed varieties selected for disease resistance, heat tolerance, and uniform bulb yield.

wheat-seed.name: Certified Wheat Seed
wheat-seed.desc: Certified high-performing wheat seed variety cultivated and conditioned for regional smallholder farming.

carrot.name: Carrot
carrot.desc: Fresh, firm-textured carrots with vibrant colour and natural sweetness, suited for domestic wholesale and export markets.
carrot.brix: High dry matter, firm Grade A

garlic.name: Garlic
garlic.desc: Pungent, tightly cloved garlic bulbs air-dried and cleaned for domestic distribution and export packing.

calendar.title: Harvest & Availability Calendar
calendar.desc: Plan your sourcing pipeline across seasonal windows in the Ethiopian Great Rift Valley.
calendar.mobileHint: Scroll horizontally to view full calendar

cta.title: Need Custom Volume or Seasonal Off-Take Terms?
cta.desc: Our export logistics team arranges refrigerated air-freight and overland distribution tailored to your procurement schedule.
